LESS COPYING. MORE CONNECTED.

What Shopify POS adds to your bookings.

Turn a conversation into a booking

Schedule an appointment while the customer is in your store. This fits salons, service retailers and businesses that regularly arrange a follow-up visit.

Take the in-person payment

The documented POS flow supports creating the booking and collecting payment with Shopify’s POS system. Payment and hardware requirements belong to your Shopify setup.

One booking system for both channels

Bookings made through POS are synchronized to Cowlendar. Your team can work with online and in-person reservations in the same booking system.

Manage the reservation at the desk

The help center documents viewing and managing bookings from POS, including rescheduling and cancellation workflows. Test your staff’s intended actions and permissions.

CONNECT IT WITH CONFIDENCE

Three steps to your first test booking.

  1. 01

    Prepare the services

    Configure and test the services in Cowlendar first. Make sure the durations, prices and availability are ready for an actual customer.

  2. 02

    Add Cowlendar to POS

    Open the official Shopify POS app, sign into the store with Cowlendar installed and add the Cowlendar app tile. Use the current setup guide for the tile flow.

  3. 03

    Run a counter booking

    Schedule a test appointment and check its payment, Cowlendar record and online availability. Have the relevant staff member try the workflow.

KNOW HOW IT BEHAVES

Booking software meets your retail setup.

Your POS device, Shopify plan, payment hardware and staff access determine how the counter operates. Cowlendar adds the appointment workflow. Validate them together so a teammate can book a service and find the reservation again after checkout.

Shopify POS support is required

Use a Shopify setup that supports your intended POS features. Hardware, POS subscriptions and payment-processing costs are separate.

Booking changes and payment changes differ

When a customer cancels or reschedules, inspect both the reservation and the payment outcome. Do not assume a calendar change automatically refunds an order.

Start with one complete service

Test the full desk journey before rolling it out across your whole service menu or every location.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Shopify POS questions, answered.

Can I book appointments in Shopify POS?

Yes. Cowlendar’s POS documentation describes scheduling manual bookings and collecting payments in the Shopify POS app.

Will POS bookings appear in Cowlendar?

Yes. The documented integration connects POS reservations to Cowlendar so online and in-person bookings can be managed together.

Is Shopify POS included in the Cowlendar price?

No. Shopify plans, POS features, compatible hardware and payment fees are separate from your Cowlendar subscription.

Can I rebook a customer after a salon visit?

Yes. Follow-up appointments are a documented use case. Set up the service, add the Cowlendar tile and test the booking with the staff who use the counter.
